ImageDescription.value: Our hired car - an Indian built Maruti, Malta, April 1992. It is a license-built Suzuki Alto with an 800cc inline 3 engine. Looks like a 1997 model. On the driver's side it had a safety belt - but no stalk to put it in. Somehow it had been forgotten when building it. The firm hiring it to me told me not to worry as it wasn't legally required to wear saftey belts in Malta. Although they were supposed to drive on the left like the UK, in practice they tended to drive in the middle of the road as the sides were a bit rough.
